crs.defined.description: Each georeferenced input declares a CRS.

crs.consistent.description: Inputs that are combined share one CRS; a mismatch fails until they are reprojected.

crs.metric_operation.description: A distance, area, or buffer operation runs in a projected horizontal CRS with metre or foot units, not in degrees or geocentric coordinates.

geometry.valid.description: Every geometry is valid (no self-intersections or invalid rings).

geometry.non_empty.description: No null or empty geometries are present.

geometry.type_consistent.description: The layer holds one geometry family; single and multi-part types count together.

geometry.winding.description: GeoJSON polygon rings follow the RFC 7946 right-hand rule: counterclockwise exteriors, clockwise holes.

scope.record_count.description: The output feature count is compared with a reference dataset's count.

raster.nodata_declared.description: Every raster band declares a nodata value.

raster.resampling.description: The resampling method suits categorical data (nearest or mode).

raster.grid_alignment.description: Rasters share CRS, pixel size, and pixel-grid origin so they can be combined.

raster.cog_layout.description: Heuristic layout screen for GeoTIFFs: tiled, with internal overviews unless the raster fits in one block, and not lossy JPEG; not COG validation.

rs.reflectance_range.description: Sampled plausibility screen: reflectance values lie within [-0.5, 1.5]; non-finite scale, offset, or values fail. Not a calibration check.

rs.index_range.description: Sampled plausibility screen: spectral index values lie within [-1, 1]; non-finite scale, offset, or values fail.

stac.provenance.description: A STAC Item records a time and a projection code.

rs.scale_applied_once.description: Sampled output pixels equal the input DN through the declared calibration (raster scale/offset metadata, or a product encoding such as s2-l2a or landsat-c2-l2) exactly once; raw DN or a twice-applied calibration fails. Comparison is on a fixed stride and says nothing about other processing steps.

rs.cloud_mask_applied.description: Pixels flagged as cloud or shadow by an aligned QA raster (Sentinel-2 SCL classes 3, 8, 9, 10; Landsat QA_PIXEL bits 1-4) are nodata or NaN in the output; unaligned grids are not-run.

rs.temporal_scope.description: Every STAC item datetime, or the whole start/end interval, falls inside a declared time range; items without a usable acquisition time are not-run.

sar.value_domain.description: Sampled backscatter values lie in the domain declared by the expected scale (sigma0-db within [-50, 15] dB; sigma0-linear non-negative with p99 <= 5). Flags decibel/linear confusion as one possible cause; not a calibration check.

sar.geocoded.description: A raster carries both a CRS and a non-identity geotransform; GCP-only geometry or an identity transform fails as not geocoded.

accuracy.sample_design.description: Every map class in the reference-sample CSV has at least min_per_class samples (default 50, a configurable rule of thumb); missing class areas when area estimates are requested are warned.

accuracy.estimates.description: Confusion matrix, user's and area-weighted producer's accuracy, overall accuracy, and the stratified area-adjusted area of each reference class with 95% confidence intervals (Olofsson et al. 2014, eqs. 5-6 and 10-12); not-run when map-class areas are missing.

provenance.reproducible.description: A written run manifest verifies: recorded input/output files re-hash identically and recorded tool versions still match; warns on tool-version drift, fails on changed or missing files, an edited manifest core, or a recorded path outside the workspace.

preflight.metric_crs.description: Plan check: a declared distance, area, or buffer step runs in a projected horizontal CRS with metre or foot units, not in a geographic or geocentric CRS.

preflight.alignment.description: Plan check: inputs declared for combination or comparison share a CRS, pixel size, and pixel-grid origin, or the plan declares a reprojection/alignment step.

preflight.categorical_resampling.description: Plan check: a declared categorical layer (classification, mask, or QA band) is resampled with nearest neighbour or mode, not with a bilinear or cubic kernel.

preflight.reflectance_decode.description: Plan check: an 'expect reflectance' operation on integer raster inputs that carry a non-trivial scale or offset declares a decode step. Reads the plan and input encoding metadata only; it does not compare outputs or show how often a decode was actually applied.

preflight.temporal_scope.description: Plan check: the requested analysis time range contains the datetimes of the STAC items or inputs the plan selects.

preflight.index_inputs.description: Plan check: an 'expect index' operation on integer raster inputs that carry a non-trivial scale or offset declares a decode step, so the index would be computed on decoded values rather than raw DN. Reads the plan and input encoding metadata only; it does not verify that the bands a given index needs are present or that any formula was applied.

preflight.output_units.description: Plan check: the output CRS units match the measurement units the plan requests, so a metric result is not written in degrees or the reverse.
